description: Allow or deny, with the reason and the rule. Takes an item (GTIN or catalogue id; optional), the ship-to market, the actor class and, when no record exists yet, the product type, ingredients and claims. Returns one of twelve reason codes (ALLOW · REQUIRE_NOTIFICATION · REQUIRE_RESPONSIBLE_PERSON · DENY_NOT_PERMITTED_HERE · DENY_INGREDIENT_BANNED · DENY_INGREDIENT_LIMIT · DENY_CLAIM · DENY_MARKET · DENY_ACTOR_CLASS · DENY_UNLICENSED_AGENT · DENY_NO_GTIN · DENY_NOT_VERIFIED), the rule-set version, the source page and a decision_id for the downstream tools.
